p: old men: Signifying the princes, the priests, and the governors.

this been in your days: He calls the Jews to the consideration of God's judgments, who had now plagued the fruits of the ground for the space of four years, which was because of their sins, and to call them to repentance.
drunkards: Meaning, that the reason for their excess and drunkenness was taken away.
a nation is come up upon: This was another plague with which God had punished them when he stirred up the Assyrians against them.
husband of her youth: Mourn grievously as a woman who has lost her husband, to whom she has been married in her youth.
cut off from the house of: The signs of God's wrath appeared in his temple, in so much that God's service was discontinued.
the new wine is dried up: All comfort and substance for nourishment is taken away.
Gird yourselves: He shows that the only means to avoid God's wrath, and to have all things restored, is true repentance.
day of the LORD is at: We see by these great plagues that utter destruction is at hand.
fire hath devoured the pastures of: That is, drought.
